content.text:
Certainly! Here are some moderately sophisticated chicken dinner recipes that align with your dietary restrictions and utilize your available appliances:



**Air Fryer Chicken and Broccoli Casserole**  
This dish combines seasoned diced chicken, sautéed onions, garlic, white rice, heavy cream, chicken broth, broccoli florets, and shredded cheddar cheese. It's cooked in the air fryer, resulting in a creamy and flavorful casserole. ([forktospoon.com](https://forktospoon.com/air-fryer-chicken-and-broccoli-casserole/?utm_source=openai))




**Air Fryer Chicken and Broccoli with Creamy Chili Mayo**  
Tender chicken pieces and broccoli are seasoned with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, and sriracha, then air-fried to perfection. Serve with a creamy chili mayo for an added kick. ([littlesunnykitchen.com](https://littlesunnykitchen.com/air-fryer-chicken-and-broccoli//?utm_source=openai))




**Air Fryer Broccoli Cheese Stuffed Chicken**  
Boneless, skinless chicken breasts are stuffed with a mixture of broccoli and cheese, then air-fried until golden brown. This dish offers a delightful combination of flavors and textures. ([foodyschmoodyblog.com](https://foodyschmoodyblog.com/air-fryer-broccoli-cheese-stuffed-chicken?utm_source=openai))




**Creamy Skillet Chicken**  
Chicken thighs are seared and then baked in a creamy sauce made with garlic, herbs, tomatoes, and olives. This dish is rich in flavor and can be served with pasta or crusty bread. ([hummingbirdthyme.com](https://hummingbirdthyme.com/creamy-skillet-chicken-recipe/?utm_source=openai))




**Air Fryer Chicken Casserole**  
A comforting casserole featuring egg noodles, shredded chicken, chicken soup, milk, cheddar cheese, crumbled bacon, fried shallots, and green onions. It's baked in the air fryer for a quick and satisfying meal. ([pocketfriendlyrecipes.com](https://www.pocketfriendlyrecipes.com/air-fryer-chicken-casserole/?utm_source=openai))


These recipes should provide a variety of flavors and cooking methods to suit your preferences and available appliances. Enjoy your cooking!
